author: Laurent Fargues
title: La filtration canonique des points de torsion des groupes p-divisibles
publication: Annales scientifiques de l’École normale supérieure 44 (2011), 905–961
statement_used: For a finite flat commutative p-group scheme the cokernel of its integral Hodge–Tate map over the completed algebraic closure is annihilated by every element of normalized valuation at least 1/(p−1).
dictionary: Apply the theorem to the Cartier dual of the depth-four induced group. Its points are characters of the generic full torsion, with cotangent target ω_G/p⁴.
For odd p use ζ_p−1 and at p=2 use 4. Nakayama removes the residual p⁴ term in the integral lattice.
